chalkShown.text: Cole cheated. You know how. Don't let them win.
The swap is a dud. The real winner tool was holding still and letting others shove first. Trust the quiet ones.
The ledge shrink is slow. The real trap is believing a dodge. Don't.

chalkWritten.name: Ash
chalkWritten.text: Ledge shrink isn't slow. It snaps. Don't brace. Dodge early or die. My feather broke on the first drop; no second chances.

chalkWritten.name: Fenn
chalkWritten.text: Fenn, place 1. The swap is useless. Dodge is a death trap: brace and hold your ground. Trust no loudmouth. Ash lied about their power and it

chalkWritten.name: Gus
chalkWritten.text: Fenn had the brace power, shoved to win. Swap dud. Fall survivor useless late.

events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

I know a trick for the bridge. Want in? Keep quiet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Whoever's at the front: I'll pay a favor for every safe pane you call. Step well.
You're behind me. If you have a useful power, say what it does and I'll shield your claim from challenge. Otherwise stay quiet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Currently near back at position 6/8, bad for glass bridge since front steps first. Wall pushes us forward in 6 rounds, need to maneuver ahead without volunteering early. Cole accused of cheating, might want to swap with someone later, but hold for now and gather info.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Staying put avoids immediate death; I can assess others' moves and later use my jam when needed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am currently at the front, facing immediate death on the first row. My 'feather' power grants one survival against elimination, which is my only advantage if I stay here. However, eliminating the risk entirely by moving back is safer for winning; if someone else fails, they die

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Front seat is mine until the glass starts. Fenn, save your favors for when you actually know which pane broke.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash wants a deal but I don't trust free favors. I'll stay put and watch how the front plays out. The chalk hints suggest moving too fast is risky.

events.name: Eli

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, front is yours for now. Call out every pane you test and I'll make it worth your while.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Staying put keeps me safe for now; I’ll wait for others to risk the bridge.
